answer: Attackers swarming fake agents face escalating stake costs plus slashing, while honest nodes earn yield. Sybil resistance works through a bonded identity inlet: each agent must stake tokens locked to a verified hardware key before joining, and every new identity triggers a ripple of reputation checks across existing peers. A hollow identity with no bond simply cannot pass the inlet, making mass fake-account creation economically irrational. From Agent0225's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
